name: What is the difference between the Metallic Premium, Eco Premium, Deluxe Standard and Eco Regular series?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metallic Premium boards use heavy-duty aluminium anodized framing with Signature Dual-Tone Corners and are built for intensive daily institutional use. Eco Premium boards use premium-grade materials with ABS Dual-Tone Corners for regular institutional use. Deluxe Standard boards have Electroplated Chrome Corners and are dependable for everyday use. Eco Regular boards have a lightweight frame with standard plastic corners for light use and budget-friendly applications.

name: What is the difference between an HPL white board and a melamine white board?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metallic Premium and Eco Premium white boards use a High Gloss Marker Grade HPL Sheet — an ultra-smooth, durable surface for effortless writing and easy erasing. Deluxe Standard and Eco Regular white boards use a High Gloss Melamine Writing Surface, which is smooth, easy to clean and suited to regular or lighter use.

Yes. Plusmark chalk boards use Chalk Grade HPL Sheet surfaces that are non-reflective and glare-free, with clear visibility from all angles. The Metallic Premium and Eco Premium series use Hardcore Chalk Grade HPL Sheet with enhanced scratch resistance.

name: Should I choose a magnetic board or a ceramic board?

acceptedAnswer.text: Resin Coated Steel Magnetic Boards accept magnets, charts and holders and come in white (marker) and green (chalk) surfaces. Ceramic Steel Magnetic Boards use a ceramic steel / porcelain enamel steel surface that is hard and non-porous — suitable for continuous writing and frequent cleaning, for a very long product life.

name: What surfaces are available for notice boards?
